note: Stone 1 English sheet (print/index.html#stone-1-english), double-sided. The story, words, heart words and questions come from the stone's read unit (data/units, app.id from data/term). "sample" has the same shape and is printed, marked SAMPLE, only while that unit does not exist yet.

pages.text: Pip has a hen. The hen is red.
The hen sat on a big net.
A cat ran up to the net.
The hen did not sit. The hen ran to Pip!

questions.clue: A cat ran up to the net.
